tools.name: add_to_shortlist
tools.description: Pin a ranked candidate to the scenario shortlist for decision review.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

candidateId.description: Ranked candidate id from list_candidates or inspect_candidate

tools.name: approve_proposal
tools.description: Apply a staged proposal after human confirmation. Without confirmed:true returns pending_planner with proposalId.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

proposalId.description: Staged proposal id from stage_proposal awaiting planner approval

confirmed.description: Set true after the planner clicks Approve proposal in the UI

tools.name: approve_scenario
tools.description: Use when the user says 'record decision' or 'approve scenario'; returns pending_planner until planner clicks Approve. Without confirmed:true the decision is not saved until the planner confirms in the workspace banner.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

confirmed.description: Set true after the planner confirms in the workspace UI

tools.name: compare_scenarios
tools.description: Compare scenarios using consistent calculated metrics (capacity, transit, scores). Requires two scenario IDs from list_scenarios with hasResults: true.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

tools.name: create_scenario_branch
tools.description: Duplicate a scenario so edits do not mutate the parent. Call set_active_scenario to work on the new branch.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

name.description: Display name for the new scenario branch (e.g. "Transit 900m variant").

fromScenarioId.description: Source scenario to duplicate; defaults to active scenario

tools.name: exclude_features
tools.description: Exclude selected map parcels by feature id (same as map parcel Exclude toolbar); marks results stale.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

featureIds.description: Parcel feature ids from map selection

tools.name: exclude_from_selection
tools.description: Exclude parcel features from analysis (alias for exclude_features).

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

featureIds.description: Parcel feature ids from map selection

tools.name: exclude_map_area

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

label.description: Human-readable label for the exclusion polygon shown in constraints

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generate a planning report for one or more scenarios. Without confirmed:true returns pending_planner for on-screen review.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioIds.description: Scenario ids to include; defaults to active scenario

title.description: Optional report title; defaults to a scenario-based name

tools.name: get_analysis_plan
tools.description: Return the structured analysis plan steps before or after running analysis.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

tools.name: get_planning_constraints
tools.description: One-shot read of planning constraints for the active scenario: objective, enabled constraints, dataset limitations, flood/transit thresholds, stale flag, and housing target vs eligible capacity.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Read the active project and currently active scenario only: objective, constraints, decision status, resume note, and analysis summary. Call list_scenarios for all branches.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

tools.name: inspect_candidate
tools.description: Inspect one candidate: metrics, score breakdown, datasets, assumptions, limitations.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

candidateId.description: Ranked candidate id from list_candidates or inspect_candidate

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: List ranked analysis candidates (top N by default) with total count and score spread — does not return the full candidate set. For housing capacity and detailed metrics per site, call inspect_candidate.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

offset.description: Skip this many ranked candidates before returning the page (default 0)

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List datasets with version, freshness, coverage, and limitations.

tools.name: list_decisions
tools.description: Recent planner decisions and scenario preferences (approvals, rejections, candidate rejections, prefer_scenario). Use for audit — get_workspace only shows decisionStatus on the active scenario.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

scenarioId.description: Optional — filter to one scenario; omit for all branches

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List saved planning projects (id, name, geography). Use open_project to navigate by id or name.

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description: List all scenario branches for a project: id, name, active flag, whether results exist, stale flag, and decision status.

projectId.description: Planning project id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active project.

tools.description: List planner-pinned candidates on the scenario shortlist with pin reasons and notes.

scenarioId.description: Scenario id. Optional when a workspace tab is open — defaults to the active scenario.

tools.name: load_project
tools.description: Read-only snapshot of a project workspace (alias for get_workspace). Does not navigate — use open_project or visit workspaceUrl.

projectId.description: Planning project id

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open an existing planning project in the browser (navigates to its workspace URL). Pass projectId or name (case-insensitive; unique partial match allowed).

projectId.description: Planning project id from list_projects

name.description: Project display name when projectId is unknown

tab.description: Tab to open: workspace (map), results, evidence, compare, decision, activity, or report
